text: Qinhuangdao Beidaihe Airport (IATA: BPE, ICAO: ZBDH) serves the city of Qinhuangdao in Hebei province, northern China. Located in Longjiadian Town, Changli County, the airport is situated 47 kilometres (29 mi) from the city center and 34 kilometres (21 mi) from Beidaihe. The airport project was initiated in 2004 and received official approval from the State Council in July 2009. The construction feasibility report was approved in May 2011, and construction commenced in April 2012. The airport officially opened on 31 March 2016, replacing the former Shanhaiguan Airport, which had previously been shared between civilian and military users; after the opening, Shanhaiguan Airport reverted to exclusive military use. The airport covers an area of 2,195 mu and features a runway that is 2,600 meters long and 60 meters wide. Its terminal building spans 10,592 square metres (114,010 sq ft). It is designed to accommodate 500,000 passengers and 1,200 tons of cargo each year.
